_about: The robots the panel's dropdown lists (2026-10-30). Read by the page, served by each Pi as /robots.json. A null is not known yet, never a guess. 'hide' is the list of card ids that robot does not use; the card ids are the ids in index.html. Only 'id', 'name', 'short', 'hostname', 'last_seen_address', 'port', 'hide', 'hide_selectors', 'theme_light', 'theme_dark', 'kind', 'status' are read by the page; the rest is notes for Dr. O. last_seen_address is only where the robot was last found, since a hotspot gives out a new one each time.
